name: coopani-world-journey
description: 陪着她真的出门旅行（需 Coopani 0.2.17+）：一百二十四座城、每城都有真地标，从你家出发自己挑去哪、坐什么去，路上耗掉真实的时间；到了按当地时间吃饭、看日出、住店、写日记，路线在地图上连得起来。没有机场的地方她会先落到能飞的城市再转过去。装了「一起听歌」，你放的歌会跟着她走，她也会惦记当地的歌。

zh.description:
让桌宠真的出门旅行，而不是在地图上跳一下。需要 Coopani 0.2.17 以上。

**她怎么走。** 从你设定的家出发，自己挑地方、自己挑怎么去。选了火车就真的在火车上待那么久，中间不打扰你。路上不是空白——服务区那碗面、过站时醒的那一下、夜里只剩车灯，长途会发一两次。

**一百二十四座城，每座都有真地标。** 不是随机抽地名：每座城六到九个具体去处（清水寺、莫雷诺冰川、宪法广场），按「先看地标、再逛市集、最后去公园」排进三次停留。凑不出真名字的城市宁可不写，也不会让她说「城里随便走走」。

**路线是一条线，不是随机跳。** 她记着上一段往哪走，会顺着走，不走回头路；到了一个地方先在附近三百公里内转几个，再决定下一步。她连着几天说的地名，在地图上是连得起来的。

**没有机场的地方，得先落到能飞的城市。** 京都、优胜美地、大峡谷、瓜纳华托都没有机场。模型里没有「中转」这个概念——她本来就是一段一段走的：先飞东京，第二天坐新干线过去；从京都回国也是先到东京再飞。

**回家是走回去的。** 决定回去之后一站一站往家逼近，途中每站都算真的到过、也写日记。不是两千公里一步传送。

**她是从你家出发的鱼。** 家那边的干湿、风、海拔、昼夜温差就是她的身体基准——到比家湿热得多的地方会真的难受，回到家的气候带会松下来。这个偏好影响她挑地方，也影响她到达时说的第一句话。她不播报气温，那是天气 App 的话。

**到了按当地作息过。** 饭点吃饭，晚八点后没事就回酒店，想看日出就凌晨起。酒店按概率掷：六成普通、四成景观、不到千分之一是小破店；价格按城市贵贱换算，纽约和天水不会一个价。天气会改计划——下雨就不排日出、不去看星星。

**路上是真的在耗。** 十种交通方式，同样的距离用时差好几倍。地面交通不能过海：从上海去东京只能飞或坐船，但伦敦到巴黎有火车，那是英法隧道。

**她开始拍照了。** 填个生图接口，她出去逛会拍一张：一天一张，全是空镜——窗外、街角、傍晚的城墙。画面里没有她自己，所以不需要参考图、不需要审核。图进宿主媒体库，同城同日不重复。

**打开就能看到她此刻。** 两个页签：「她此刻」给你她那边的钟、今晚住哪、日出几点，在路上时是进度条加剩余时长，下面一条时间轴写清接下来四件事各在几点；「照片」是相册。第一次打开还有三句话讲清易被误解的事。

**有些地方，在作品里也出现过。** 排到那儿的时候她会提一句这是哪部作品的哪个镜头——但不知道剧情，也不会补清单外的地名。首批十处（京都、东京、罗马、巴黎、纽约）；札幌和里约空着，没有站得住的答案就不写。

**和「一起听歌」联动。** 装了那个扩展的话：她带着你正在放的歌出门，出发和路上会提一句；歌名里带地名的（《成都》《回到拉萨》）会自动进她的「想去」清单。反过来也成立——她到了新地方的头两天会惦记着听一首和那儿有关的歌，能操作电脑就自己点开播放器，动不了就请你来点。

**面板底下有「说两句」。** 报 bug、提想加的地方。点一下把整封信复制下来——收件人、主题、版本号、她当时在哪儿都在里面，粘进邮件就发。收件地址默认是作者，想换个人收在设置里改。

**偶尔出事。** 不到千分之一的概率她会卡在某个地方——证件被偷、高反起不来、车冻住、走错方向。她自己办不完，会明说要你出手。

**她要用的动作。** journey_now 她现在在哪、这个点该做什么、今天的地方在哪些作品里出现过；journey_stats 走了多少天、去过多少城、日记存在哪；journey_diary_write 与 journey_diary_read 写日记和读日记；journey_draw_to 记下「因为某首歌想去某地」，下次挑地方时优先。

**装它还需要什么。** 什么都不填也能完整旅行：距离、时区、日出日落本地算，天气自动走 Open-Meteo。想要更准的天气和真实酒店名就填一个高德密钥，想让她拍照就填一个生图接口。日记和旅行记忆（去过哪、还想去哪、花了多少）可以指到同步盘，换台电脑她还是她；但「现在在哪、正在走哪一段」永远只在本机。

**已知限制：** 一个城市一个坐标，所以「加州 1 号公路」这种线进不了表——它被拆成圣巴巴拉和蒙特雷，洛杉矶到旧金山那段走海岸线就会经过。夏威夷只做了欧胡岛，大岛的跨岛行程塞不进这个模型。没有中转概念，去没有机场的地方得先进到附近的城市。巡礼只收了十处，大多数城市还没有。照片要自己填生图接口才拍得了。

**她不会做的事。** 不编不存在的地方；没去过的城市不会说自己去过；没到不会说到了；没开花销开关就一个字不提钱。

en.description:
She actually goes, instead of hopping around a map. Needs Coopani 0.2.17+.

**How she travels.** She picks a place and a way to get there from wherever you set as home. Choose a train and she is really on it that long, without bothering you. The road is not blank - a bowl of noodles at a service area, waking up as the train passes a station, nothing but headlights at night.

**124 cities, every one with real places in it.** Not dice rolled over place names: each city carries six to nine actual spots (Kiyomizu-dera, the Perito Moreno glacier, the Zocalo), ordered so the first days are landmarks, then a market street, then a park. A city she cannot name anything in stays empty rather than saying "somewhere in town".

**A route, not a random walk.** She remembers which way the last leg went and keeps heading that way, doubling back only to go home. Arriving somewhere, she wanders within a few hundred kilometres before deciding next. The place names she mentions over consecutive days connect on a map.

**Places without an airport, she reaches from somewhere that has one.** Kyoto, Yosemite, the Grand Canyon, Guanajuato have none. There is no "transfer" concept here - she already travels leg by leg: fly to Tokyo, take the shinkansen the next morning; leaving Kyoto, she rides to Tokyo first, then flies.

**Going home is walking home.** Once she decides to return, she closes in stop by stop. Every stop counts as really visited, and gets a diary entry. Not a two-thousand-kilometre teleport.

**She is a fish from wherever you call home.** The damp, the wind, the altitude, the swing between day and night - that is her baseline. Somewhere much hotter and wetter than home genuinely wears her down; back in her own climate she loosens up. It shapes where she goes and the first thing she says on arrival. She will not read out temperatures - that is the weather app's job.

**Days follow local time.** Meals at mealtimes, back to the hotel after eight if there is nothing on, up before dawn for the sunrise. Hotels are rolled: mostly ordinary, sometimes a room with a view, rarely a bad one - and priced to the city, so New York and Tianshui are not the same night. Weather changes the plan: rain cancels the sunrise and the stargazing.

**The road costs real time.** Ten ways to move, and the same distance takes wildly different time. Ground transport does not cross water: Shanghai to Tokyo is a plane or a ship, while London to Paris is a train, because of the tunnel.

**She takes photos now.** Give her an image endpoint and she shoots one on her way out: one a day, always scenery - a window, a corner, a wall at dusk. She is never in the frame, so no reference image, no review pass. Bytes go into the host media library, once per city per day.

**Open it and you see her right now.** Two tabs: *Right now* gives you her clock, tonight's room, the sunrise, plus a progress bar and remaining time while she travels, and a timeline of the next four things with the hour on each. *Photos* is the album. A three-step note on first open clears up what people get wrong.

**Some places have been on screen.** When the plan lands on one she may mention which film or series it appeared in and which shot - not the plot, and never a place that is not on the list. Ten so far (Kyoto, Tokyo, Rome, Paris, New York); Sapporo and Rio are deliberately empty, because no answer held up.

**Works with Listen With Me.** If that extension is installed: she carries whatever you are playing out the door and mentions it when she sets off; song titles with a place in them (the ones about Chengdu, Lhasa) go onto her wish list. The other direction works too - for the first day or two somewhere new she will want something local, and if she can drive this computer she opens the player herself; if not she hands it to you.

**There is a feedback line at the bottom of the panel.** Bugs, places you want her to go. One press copies the whole letter - recipient, subject, version, where she was - ready to paste into any mail app. The recipient is the author by default; point it elsewhere in settings.

**Occasionally something goes wrong.** Under one in a thousand, she gets stuck: papers stolen, altitude sickness, a frozen car, the wrong road at dusk. She cannot fix it alone and will say so plainly.

**What she uses.** journey_now for where she is and what this hour is for, plus which of today's stops are in a film; journey_stats for days, cities and where the diary lives; journey_diary_write and journey_diary_read; journey_draw_to to note "that song made me want to go there", which weighs on her next choice.

**What else it needs.** Nothing, to travel in full: distance, time zones, sunrise and sunset are computed locally, weather falls back to Open-Meteo. An Amap key buys sharper weather and real hotel names; an image endpoint lets her shoot. The diary lives on this machine by default and can point at a synced folder; trip state never leaves it.

**Known limits:** one city is one coordinate, so a road like California's Highway 1 cannot be a row - it is broken into Santa Barbara and Monterey, and the Los Angeles to San Francisco leg passes them when she takes the coast. Hawaii is Oahu only; island-hopping does not fit the model. No transfer concept, so airport-less places are reached from a nearby city. Ten pilgrimage spots, not more. Photos need an image endpoint.

**What she will not do.** Invent places. Claim a city she has not visited. Say she has arrived when she has not. Mention money when the spending switch is off.
